wwo.name: Calcutta
wwo.method: Hand transcription of linked period street centres, built ground, open ground, historic shoreline and wet docks. Ordinary buildings use the sample kit within the shaded or clearly built perimeters. Width, storey, surface, plot spacing and building depth ranges are display estimates. Small harbour works and lanes are incomplete. No modern terrain or routes were used as historic features.

registration.reference: One WGS84 azimuthal equidistant frame fitted to one fifth of the original 4335 x 6616 city sheet. An affine fit improves held-out error over similarity, from 109.5 to 94.7 m RMS. Modern reference points register the historic sheet only. Water and roads follow the same transform.
registration.osm_attribution: © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL. https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright. Used only to locate stable point controls.

sources.title: Calcutta, Plate 38 from Constable's Hand Atlas of India
sources.publisher: Edinburgh Geographical Institute. David Rumsey Map Collection, Stanford Libraries, 11794.043.
sources.licence: Original period map is public domain. Commons marks its reproduction public domain. Scan kept in the offline source directory.
sources.precision: Street and waterfront centre lines and marked built and open ground. Individual standing buildings generally unresolved.

sources.title: Calcutta, George F. Cram 1894
sources.licence: Public domain original and reproduction per catalogue. No scan included.
sources.precision: Corroborates dense ordinary northern streets, named Kolkata structures and the old bridge alignment.

sources.title: Calcutta. Plan des Docks de Kidderpore
sources.publisher: French Ministry of Public Works, Atlas des ports étrangers. David Rumsey Map Collection, Stanford Libraries, 14306.151.
sources.licence: Public domain original period engineering drawing. Scan kept in the offline source directory.
sources.precision: Cross-checks the tidal basin, wet docks, yards and access. Only completed works confirmed on the 1893 street plan are depicted.

sources.title: Census of India 1901. The Town of Calcutta
sources.licence: Original archival census. Historical facts consulted. Scan not included.
sources.precision: Confirms the 1874 floating bridge across the Hooghly and period street fabric.

sources.title: Kidderpore Dock history in Aloke
sources.licence: Historical facts consulted. No figures or text redistributed.
sources.precision: Confirms the opening date of the historic dock facilities.
